description.en: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
description.zh: 香果胶向僵尸喷溅口香糖，把他们定在原地，并拦住其身后的僵尸。

chat.en: "I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
chat.zh: “我只嚼火腿口味的口香糖，” 香果胶自信地说着，“必须是火腿加盐味的。”

text.zh: 口香糖的强度与僵尸的强度有关

text.en: best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs
text.zh: 最好用于巨尸和机甲橄榄
